{{Quote|So we have Rimsaw Station in orbit, shared by the Alliance Navy and Starfighter Command.|[[Voort saBinring]]|<ref name="XWMK" />}}
'''Rimsaw Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]] and [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] both shared the station.<ref name="XWMK" />
